Are you a finance or investment professional with the capability to change outcomes and directly impact the business? Would you like to work with talented individuals in an innovative company where you can influence your own responsibilities and build close partnerships across portfolio management, transactions & asset management?

**About The Role

**As an Investment Performance Business Partner at Urban Partners, you will be part of the wider CIO Office team and report to the Investment Performance Director.

Joining the Investment Performance team, you will play an important role in driving performance and decision making. You will act as a tactical and strategic partner to investment owners and portfolio management across Urban Partners. As our team expands, we are searching for the right candidate to join.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Drive bi-annual Re-Underwriting process for selected countries, ensuring quality & completeness.

• Own delivery of reporting, analysis, and insights to your stakeholders.

• Execute deep dives on investments or portfolios as nominated or flagged.

• Build scenario & sensitivity analysis on investment & portfolio level.

• Support development & expansion of Inv. Perf. team capabilities.

• Develop and advance analysis framework and AI adaptation.

Your Experience & Skills In this role, you hold a relevant Master's degree and bring 2-4 years of experience from investment management, Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), forecasting, finance consulting, audit, controlling, or a similar analytical finance environment. Relevant backgrounds include Big Four firms, finance advisory, real estate controlling, and investment management. The role requires technical skills in modelling and a sound finance understanding.

**We Expect You To Bring

**

• Hands on experience and confidence working with financial statements and driver-based projections.

• Experience in investment modelling with the ability to rebuild a cash flow.

• Experience with projection/forecasting process execution.

• The ability to run analytical process, scenario analysis and sensitivity tests.

• Operational interest and understanding.

• AI application and curiosity.

• Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal. Professional proficiency in local language, with the ability to understand and engage in day-to-day business discussions, is required. Additional Nordic language skills are considered an advantage.

Your character

• Collaborative and clear in your communication, able to build a strong connection with business stakeholders.

• Comfort with disagreement. The job is to challenge experienced colleagues constructively and repeatedly, and to be welcome in the following quarter.

• Curiosity about what drives a number rather than whether it ties. A reconciler will be unhappy in this role and unhelpful in it.

**What We Offer

**Make a difference by helping create urban spaces and places that enrich people’s lives in the most sustainable way

Lead the industry with an innovator that is pioneering new approaches while raising standards and inspiring the industry

Learn and grow as part of a powerhouse of brilliant people where teamwork, feedback and different ways of thinking are at the core

Be your whole self in a purpose-driven culture with a strong sense of belonging, based on trust, celebration and caring for each other

**About Us

**This role is closely connected to colleagues in Copenhagen and to teams across the investment-performance data flow. Active collaboration and regular in-person presence are important to making those relationships work well.

The Investment Performance team sits within the CIO Office and is responsible for the methodologies, analytics, and platforms that support investment decision-making across Urban Partners. Working at the intersection of investments, data, technology, and business processes, the team drives performance management, business partnering, platform ownership, and continuous improvement to help create a scalable and future-fit investment platform

For questions, please contact Jerker Gustafsson (Investment Performance Director) at jegu@urban.partners.

jobs.description:
Director

CMC Analysis & Characterisation

CMC Analytical Execution & Technology

Location: Måløv

Your impact begins here - **Set the direction. Accelerate delivery. Transform analytical execution.

**Are you a bold and inspiring leader who can turn complexity into clear direction and strong results? As Director of CMC Analytical Execution & Technology (AET), you will lead a multidisciplinary organisation of approximately 150 employees, ensure reliable analytical delivery across a growing development portfolio, and shape the future of automation, digitalisation, and analytical technology. This is an opportunity to combine visible operational leadership with strategic influence - and build the people, partnerships, and capabilities that will advance medicines from development to patients. Apply now and help shape the future of analytical execution.

**What You’ll Do

**As Director for CMC AET, you will lead a multi-disciplinary area consisting of five operational analytical teams, one IT team, and one Technology Engineering team. Together, these teams are responsible for delivering analytical results across the entire development project portfolio, while driving digitalization, automation, and technology advancement across the area. You will ensure reliable, compliant, and efficient operations through strong leadership, clear prioritization, robust resource planning, and close collaboration with key stakeholders.

At the same time, you will define and execute the strategic roadmap for analytical execution, digital capabilities, and technology innovation, ensuring scalable solutions and future-ready capabilities that support an expanding portfolio and increasing business complexity.

**Your Key Responsibilities Will Be

**

• Lead people and organisational capability: set a clear direction, develop leaders and talents, and build a high-performing organisation with the capabilities required to support current and future business needs.

• Drive performance and execution excellence: ensure reliable, compliant, and timely analytical delivery through strong operational leadership, clear accountability, and a culture of continuous improvement.

• Set strategic direction: define and drive the long-term strategy for analytical execution, validation, release readiness, and technology enablement, balancing business priorities, future capability needs, and regulatory expectations.

• Lead and build strategic partnerships: establish trusted stakeholder relations across the value chain and create alignment around priorities, capacity, risks, and resource investments to enable successful portfolio delivery.

• Shape the future through technology and innovation: define the vision and strategic direction for automation, digitalisation, and future ways of working across AnaC. Influence organisational priorities and investments to build the capabilities needed to meet future portfolio and business demands.

Your success requires a visible, hands-on operational leadership profile combined with strong strategic judgement. You stay close to execution performance, use KPIs and lead-time data to drive action, identify risks and constraints early, and work proactively with stakeholders to remove barriers and protect delivery. With full decision authority, you set objectives with significant functional impact and take accountability for people decisions, operational performance, strategic capability development, and successful project transfers from Research to Global Manufacturing & Supply.

You report to the Vice President (VP) of CMC Analysis & Characterisation (AnaC) and will be part of the leadership team in AnaC.

**Who You’ll Work With

**CMC AnaC is responsible for analytical development, characterisation, bioanalysis, stability, comparability, validation, release and lifecycle analytical support across Novo's product portfolio.

CMC AET consists of approximately 150 employees in Måløv, organised across five execution teams responsible for validation and QC/release testing, as well as a technology team and an IT team. The department is accountable for strong day-to-day analytical execution, predictable delivery, and transparent performance management, while strategically developing the automation, digital solutions, technologies, and capabilities required for the future analytical landscape.

We offer a dynamic and fast-paced environment where operational excellence, innovation, and collaboration go hand in hand. We take ownership, challenge the status quo, and are committed to delivering high-quality analytical support to patients and the business.

**What You’ll Bring

**We are looking for a seasoned and self‑motivated leader who thrives on taking initiative and ownership. You bring:

• An MSc (minimum) and + 5 years of relevant experience, with significant experience within QC, analytical development or other relevant CMC or Product Supply disciplines.

• + 5 years of proven leadership experience with the ability to lead multi‑disciplinary teams and deliver results at a strategic level. Senior leadership experience is a requirement.

• Broad cross‑functional experience within CMC Development, with strong organisational understanding and the ability to influence at VP level.

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to present complex scientific and strategic topics to senior management.

• A demonstrated track record of driving change, challenging the status quo, and improving business outcomes.

• A strong Lean mindset and experience applying continuous improvement principles to simplify workflows, reduce lead times, improve capacity utilisation and build sustainable operational performance.

You lead with confidence, energy, and trust, creating clarity in complexity and belief in times of uncertainty. You set a strong tone of ownership and optimism - “we’ve got this” - and lead in line with Novo leadership behaviours by delivering on commitments, developing others, challenging constructively, and making decisions for the greater good.

**What You Can Expect Here

**At Novo, you can expect a role where your scientific judgement matters, your ideas are listened to, and your work helps move complex development projects forward. You will have opportunities to deepen your expertise, build cross-functional influence and grow in a collaborative environment where initiative is encouraged. You will be supported to perform at your best and trusted to take ownership, while contributing to work that helps create progress for people living with serious chronic diseases.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from DKK 940,800 to DKK 1,448,700, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short‑term and/or long‑term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks. Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. Apply before: 8 November 2026.

**Due to short deadline please apply as fast as possible.

**For further information, please contact VP CMC AnaC, Kristine Buch Uldahl, at kbuu@novonordisk.com

You do not need to attach a cover letter to your application, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying for this Director position in your CV. To ensure an efficient and fair recruitment process, please refrain from adding a photo in your CV.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

We are looking for a Head of Retail to lead and grow Tekla's retail business as it accelerates internationally. This is a senior commercial role, with full responsibility for the performance, consistency, and growth of our stores, from the shop floor through to clienteling, retail marketing, and new store openings.

Reporting directly to the Commercial & Merchandising Director, you will have direct management and commercial responsibility for all owned stores, with real accountability for retail KPIs. You will work closely with partners managing stores in some markets, as well as our internal operations, marketing, and merchandising teams.

This is a unique opportunity to shape how Tekla scales retail. As our roll-out accelerates, new locations bring more complexity and a diverse mix of operating models. You will build the routines and standards that make this expansion consistent and commercially disciplined.

While our preferred location for this role is Copenhagen, we are also open to applications from candidates based in London. Please note that, in both cases, regular travel across stores and departments will be required.

Key responsibilities of the role include, but are not limited to:

Commercial performance and store management

• Hold direct management and full commercial responsibility for all owned stores and staffed department store spaces, currently Copenhagen and London, with a growing portfolio ahead.

• Extend the same commercial oversight to partner-operated locations, ensuring consistency in practice and driving performance even where day-to-day management sits with the partner.

• Own retail KPIs across every door, including revenue, conversion, footfall, AOV, and profitability, and manage each location towards its individual target.

• Build and embed weekly and monthly performance routines that drive both engagement and consistency across the retail portfolio.

• Lead, coach, and develop store teams, setting clear standards for service, engagement, and commercial performance.

Clienteling

• Lead and implement Tekla’s clienteling strategy across all stores, building the high-value customer base that underpins the retail model.

• Own the clienteling tool: adoption, daily workflows, and reporting.

• In collaboration with marketing, define and implement a clienteling calendar, to ensure high-value customers are engaged with in a meaningful way

• Define and track the clienteling KPI set, from appointments and outreach through to follow-up quality and revenue attribution.

• Ensure high-value client relationships are developed consistently, and to the same standard, across locations.

Retail marketing and activations

• In close collaboration with marketing, own the in-store events calendar as a primary driver of qualified traffic and brand engagement, spanning clienteling events, seasonal brand moments, and cultural programming.

• In collaboration with the PR & Community team, build local partnerships and community relationships in each market to generate reach, acquisition, and repeat engagement.

• Work with the trade team to ensure the stores are best leveraged as platforms to engage with architects and interior designers.

• Overall, use each store as a live platform for brand storytelling and customer acquisition, not only as a point of sale.

Store openings and expansion

• Coordinate store opening projects end-to-end, including site readiness, operational workflows, recruitment, and onboarding.

• Adapt the operating model to different setups, from HQ-managed to partner-operated and local-lead formats.

• Build scalable routines and playbooks so that each new opening is faster and more consistent than the last.

Retail operations

• Manage the retail operations function to ensure perfect synchronisation between the front and back end of the business, across stock, systems, POS, and fulfilment.

• Ensure consistency in tools, processes, and reporting across an increasingly complex, multi-format retail portfolio, and continuously sharpen our reporting to drive diagnosis and action across the network of stores.

• Partner with operations, technology, merchandising, and e-commerce to drive process and tool improvements as the business scales, and to deliver a seamless omnichannel experience for the customer.

We’d love to hear from you if you are/have:

• A retail leader with deep experience running stores, ideally across multiple regions or markets.

• Experience managing a clienteling tool and driving a clienteling strategy. This is essential to the role.

• A proven record of driving retail KPIs and building the performance routines that lift both engagement and results across multiple doors.

• Experience in retail marketing, including events, local partnerships, and activations that generate traffic and build the brand.

• Comfortable owning store opening projects, including recruitment and onboarding, across different operating models.

• Commercially disciplined and operationally strong, able to hold consistency across a portfolio of stores with different setups.

• Ideally, a premium or luxury retail background, with a genuine feel for service, experience, and brand representation.

• Genuinely drawn to Tekla's approach to product and brand; an appreciation for considered, quality home textiles matters.

Reviewing applications and conducting interviews will take place on an ongoing basis, with the aim for the successful candidate to join us as in January. If you have a genuine interest in connecting with clients through retail, an appreciation for Tekla’s approach and a commercial mindset, we encourage you to apply.

We are seeking a Financial Controller to own the integrity of Tekla’s financial reporting across the group. The role combines technical control work, balance sheet reconciliations, consolidation and eliminations, with ownership of a growing set of tax and trade compliance obligations spanning packaging tax, EU and global VAT and customs duties.

The Financial Controller is responsible both for meeting these obligations accurately and on time, and for building the processes, controls and automation that make them repeatable as the business scales. The role sits within an AI-first function focused on operational excellence, so we are looking for someone with a strong digital mindset and a proactive approach to using AI and automation tools to enhance reporting and improve efficiency.

This is a hands-on role, instrumental in ensuring financial accuracy and supporting Tekla's profitability and growth objectives. Reporting to the Finance Director and working closely with the Accounting Manager, the Financial Controller will also contribute to a range of ad hoc financial projects and initiatives across the function.

This is a full-time position based in our open-plan, curated office in Copenhagen.

Key responsibilities of the role include, but are not limited to:

Financial Controlling & Reporting

• Design, implement and manage the group's balance sheet reconciliations, including building standardised templates and processes across multiple entities

• Prepare the monthly and year-end group consolidation, including intercompany eliminations, foreign currency translation and consolidated reporting packs

• Ensure the general ledger is supported by complete, reviewed and documented reconciliations in every period. While taking a hands-on approach to booking journals and ad hoc analysis.

Tax & Trade Compliance

• Own end-to-end packaging tax obligations, including data capture, calculation and filing

• Perform compliance reviews over packaging tax, taking a proactive approach as Tekla's global footprint grows

• Analyse customs and import duties, covering tariff classification, country of origin, preferential rates and duty paid versus duty due, and identify recovery and savings opportunities

Financial Analysis & Performance

• Monitor cash flow, working capital, and financial performance metrics

• Perform variance and accuracy analyses to validate forecasts, budgets, and data integrity, encouraging transparency and accountability

• Investigate material variances and implement process improvements that enhance forecasting precision and analytical rigour

• Provide insightful financial analysis to support business planning, cost efficiencies and strategic priorities

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support business objectives

Process Improvement & Automation

• Drive continuous improvement by leveraging AI and emerging technologies to enhance financial processes, systems, and reporting tools

• Support the automation programme within the accounting team, including Intrastat and VAT reporting

• Review and implement continual improvements in Business Central, including VAT code configuration, VAT statements and financial reports

• Strengthen documentation and controls across all owned processes so they are auditable and transferable

We'd love to hear from you if you are / have:

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field

• Strong knowledge of accounting principles, financial reporting standards and tax regulations

• Demonstrable experience of group consolidation and intercompany eliminations in a multi-entity, multi-currency environment

• Strong working knowledge of global VAT and sales tax concepts

• Exposure to packaging tax regimes is an advantage

• Experience designing and operating a balance sheet reconciliation control framework

• Confident ERP user, ideally Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central

• Demonstrable experience using AI tools such as Claude to optimise and automate financial processes and reporting, for example building reporting dashboards, automating reconciliation and compliance workflows, or analysing large transactional data sets

• Advanced Excel skills and comfort working with large transactional data sets

• Experience from a high-growth business within fashion, textiles or luxury consumer goods is an advantage

• An entrepreneurial mindset with strong interpersonal skills

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English

Applications will be reviewed and interviews conducted on an ongoing basis, with the aim of the successful candidate joining us as soon as possible.

To help align expectations early, this role offers a salary range of 50,000 to 55,000 DKK per month, depending on experience and the overall interview assessment. This range is exclusive of pension, which is paid on top, along with health insurance and our other benefits.

Tekla makes high-quality home textiles, with a focus on craftsmanship, sustainability, and timeless design. We sell through our own e-commerce platform, our stores in Copenhagen and London, and wholesale partners around the world. As we grow across channels and markets, we are building the operational and technological foundation to support that growth.

We are looking for a Data Analytics Engineer to bring our data in-house and build the foundation the whole company relies on. This is a new role and our first dedicated data hire. Today an external partner builds and runs our data platform. You will take it over, own it end to end, and shape how everyone at Tekla works with data and AI.

Reporting to the Technology Lead, you will form Tekla's core technology team together. Data only creates value when it drives action, so you will spend a good share of your time with colleagues across the business, making sure what you build answers real questions and becomes part of how people work. In your first year, the priority is to bring the data foundation in-house, then to support analytics, then to open up data to AI.

Day to day, you will work with ecommerce and marketing on attribution, tracking, and channel reporting; merchandising and planning on product, stock, and sales data; finance on reporting and reconciliation against the ERP; retail and wholesale on store and B2B performance; and operations on demand, supply, and warehouse data. During the transition you will also work closely with our data partner, and with our commerce platform and ERP partners.

This is a full-time position based in Copenhagen, Denmark. The role sits in our open-plan office, working closely with the wider team day to day.

Key responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Data foundation

• Lead the handover of our data platform from our external partner, covering pipelines, warehouse, and semantic layer.

• Own extraction and ELT pipelines, currently in Weld, from our ERP, Medusa, and marketing platforms into BigQuery.

• Own the dbt project: dimensional models, tests, documentation, and CI/CD.

• Own the semantic layer, currently in Power BI, and help decide its future direction.

• Monitor data quality across systems, so data arrives complete and accurate.

• Make sure data is stored, accessed, and shared in line with data protection law, including when AI tools use it.

Analytics support

• Work with colleagues across the business to turn their questions into well-defined models and metrics.

• Extend the data foundation with new models and metrics as the business needs them.

• Help teams build dashboards and analyses in Power BI, Mixpanel, and Claude that lead to better decisions.

Data and AI

• Rework the data model and semantic layer so Claude and other AI agents can query it reliably.

• Take our AI dashboard prototype forward into a tool that lets anyone at Tekla build and share a dashboard in minutes.

• Build small internal tools where a dashboard or an AI skill is not enough.

• Help colleagues learn to direct AI tools well and build their own processes around them.

We would love to hear from you if you are, or have:

• 4+ years of experience in data engineering or analytics engineering.

• A bachelor's degree in a relevant field, such as computer science, statistics, mathematics, engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

• Hands-on experience building and running a modern data stack, including ELT tooling such as Weld, BigQuery, and dbt.

• Strong SQL and dimensional modelling skills.

• Experience building dashboards in a common tool such as Power BI, Looker, or Tableau.

• Experience with API integrations.

• Good engineering habits: version control, testing, documentation, and CI/CD.

• Comfortable using AI tools such as Claude in your daily work, and keen to help others do the same.

• A clear communicator with a strong eye for detail.

It is an advantage if you have:

• Experience with Power BI or Mixpanel.

• Experience with ERP data, ideally Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.

• Experience in retail, e-commerce, or omnichannel businesses.

• Web development experience, to prototype new data-driven tools.

Applications will be reviewed and interviews conducted on an ongoing basis, with the aim of the successful candidate joining us in December.

Senior Outsourcing Manager

**Your impact begins here

**As Senior Outsourcing Manager, you will lead the outsourcing projects that keep Novo’s drug development moving. Working with experts across Novo and external CMO partners worldwide, you will drive strong progress and high-quality deliveries from project start to completion. You will also be part of shaping global strategic CMO collaborations, bringing new treatments closer to the people who need them. Your impact begins with every project you lead.

**What You’ll Bring

**You bring solid drug development experience and the confidence to lead across functions and organisations.

• A MSc or PhD in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Engineering or another relevant life science.

• 4–6+ years of experience from the pharmaceutical, biotechnology or another highly regulated industry.

• A strong understanding of the R&D value chain, drug development processes and Current Good Manufacturing Practice (cGMP) requirements.

• Experience with outsourcing, CMO/CDMO collaboration and ideally contract negotiations.

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, and the ability to navigate a complex, interdisciplinary organisation.

• The ability to create structure, turn information into clear presentations and build trust across functions and with external partners.

• A proactive, positive and independent way of working, and the ability to manage several tasks at once in a fast-paced environment.

• Fluency in written and spoken English.

**What You’ll Do

**You will manage outsourcing projects within drug substance and chemical synthesis, and make sure Novo and its CMO partners work as one team.

• Lead outsourcing projects from initiation to completion, keeping progress strong and deliveries high in quality.

• Select and approve CMOs, and build collaborative external partnerships.

• Negotiate and maintain relevant agreements in close collaboration with Contract Managers.

• Protect Novo’s intellectual property rights while delivering high-quality assessments on time.

• Bring colleagues across Novo together, using informal leadership to influence decisions, drive progress and lead complex projects with colleagues and partners.

• You will have significant responsibility and visibility across the business unit, using your informal leadership to influence decisions, drive progress, and lead complex projects with colleagues and partners.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join the CMC Outsourcing & Business Development team in CMC Development, part of Global Manufacturing & Supply. CMC Development develops, manufactures and distributes drug candidates for non-clinical and clinical trials. The CMC Outsourcing team supports the Novo development pipeline and has around 30 experienced colleagues responsible for sourcing and outsourcing activities across CMC Development.

Based in Bagsværd, you will work with external CMO partners globally and with colleagues across Global Research, Quality, Regulatory, Chemical Development, Manufacturing Development, Purchasing and Commercial Manufacturing. Close collaboration with Contract Managers will help you move agreements forward. You will have significant responsibility and visibility across the business unit, and the clarity you create around priorities will help teams decide, act and deliver.

jobs.occupation: Optimizing grazing management for biodiversity in semi-natural habitats: evidence from monitoring, remote sensing and field experiments
jobs.description:
Applicants are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Ecoscience programme. The position is available from 1 March 2027.

Research area and project description:

How can grazing management be optimized to benefit both biodiversity and nature-based beef production? This PhD project will address this question through analyses of long-term biodiversity monitoring data, development of digital biodiversity indicators, and field experiments in Danish semi-natural habitats.

Grazing is a key ecological process in many ecosystems. However, biodiversity outcomes depend on how grazing is managed, including grazing intensity and timing. Despite its widespread use as a conservation tool, important knowledge gaps remain regarding which grazing strategies deliver the greatest biodiversity benefits and how these outcomes can be documented in a robust and scalable way.

The PhD project is part of the interdisciplinary Nature&Beef initiative and will combine ecology, biodiversity monitoring, remote sensing and data science. The selected candidate will work with unique datasets from the Danish national biodiversity monitoring programme (NOVANA), field experiments, drone imagery and other digital monitoring approaches.

The project will focus on four interconnected themes:

• 
Identifying grazing practices associated with positive biodiversity outcomes using long-term monitoring data.

• 
Evaluating the effects of grazing intensity and grazing season on biodiversity in a large-scale field experiment.

• 
Developing and validating image-based indicators of vegetation structure and biodiversity condition from field and drone imagery.

• 
Contributing to the development of AI-based methods for mapping vegetation and habitat condition from drone images.

The project offers an opportunity to contribute to evidence-based conservation and the development of practical tools that can support land managers, farmers, conservation practitioners and value-chain actors in documenting biodiversity outcomes. The findings will help build a stronger scientific foundation for biodiversity-friendly grazing practices and nature-based beef production.

Qualifications and specific competences:

Applicants to the PhD position must have a Master’s degree (120 ECTS) in biology or equivalent. The applicants have documented experience in botanical surveys including species identification skills of North-European flora. The applicant must have a driver license applicable in Denmark. Demonstrated proficiency in data management and analysis, image analysis, and experience using R.

Place of employment and place of work:

The place of employment is Aarhus University, and the place of work is C.F. Møllers Allé 8, building 1110, 8000 Aarhus C, Denmark.

Factbird helps manufacturers turn real-time production data into decisions they can actually act on. Since 2016, we've helped manufacturers in 28 countries cut waste, boost uptime, and run smarter — from the shop floor to the boardroom. Over 300 companies trust us to make sense of their operations, and we're a team of 80+ people across Copenhagen and the US who care about making complex things simple.

We're creating a new role at the top of our Engineering career ladder: Lead Architect. It's the senior end of our Technical Track — the rung above Tech Lead — and today it's a role we've deliberately left lightly defined, because we want the first person in it to help define it. You'll set Factbird's technical direction: architecture, tooling, and the multi-year technology bets that shape where the product goes next.

This is our most senior technical role, with no direct reports — your authority comes from judgment and track record, not the org chart. You'll work alongside our Tech Leads in Factbird's technical leadership group, partner closely with our Director of Engineering, and be the person other senior engineers go to when a decision is genuinely hard to reverse.

About the Role

As Lead Architect, you own Factbird's company-wide technical vision: the architecture our services run on, the tooling and standards our engineers use every day, and the multi-year technology strategy that ties it all together. You make — or sign off on — the high-stakes, hard-to-reverse architecture calls, and you're accountable for getting them right with the full context of where the business is headed, not just where the code is today.

You'll work across a team built on Rust, React, Node.js, and AWS, with AI-assisted development already a core part of how we ship. Some of what this role owns is already well-defined — reviewing RFCs, stewarding language and platform standards, setting the team's AI-tooling strategy. Some of it isn't yet: Factbird is still a growing company, and part of the job is helping us figure out what technical leadership at this level should look like as we scale.

You'll thrive here if you'd rather be trusted with genuinely hard calls than manage a team, and if you can hold both the technical detail and the commercial context — cost, risk, market direction — well enough to make a technology bet you can still defend a year later.

What you'll do

Architecture & technical strategy

• Own Factbird's multi-year technology strategy, and make the high-stakes architecture calls that are hard to reverse — with cost, risk, and business context factored in, not just engineering elegance

• Author and drive major RFCs from proposal through to an actual decision, and review the highest-risk architecture changes across the team

• Act as steward for our core languages and frameworks — setting standards, library choices, and the platform's overall shape

• Make build-vs-buy calls for new technical capabilities, and bring a clear point of view on emerging technologies worth adopting

• Define the observability, reliability, and security posture the platform is held to

Tooling & standards

• Set the team's technical tooling and platform standards, and keep them evolving as the stack and the company grow

• Define Factbird's strategy for AI-assisted development — which tools we adopt, how we balance velocity against code quality, security, and IP risk, and where we draw the line

• Shape engineering-wide quality philosophy and help set the technical bar used in hiring interviews

• Help define shared components and reference architecture that other engineers build on, rather than reinvent

• Give input into technical org design and team topology as Engineering scales

Technical leadership & mentorship

• Act as the trusted technical advisor to our Director of Engineering and the technical leadership group, partnering with Tech Leads and Product Leads on cross-team alignment

• Mentor senior engineers and Tech Leads toward architect-level thinking, without formal ownership of their people management

• Communicate technical vision and trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders, including leadership

• Identify technical risks to the business early, and say so before they become expensive

• Represent Factbird's technical thinking externally where it makes sense — a talk, a blog post, an open-source contribution — though this isn't a requirement on day one

What we’re looking for

We're looking for someone who's already earned this kind of trust somewhere else — someone whose technical opinions carry weight because they're right more often than not, and who'd rather solve the interesting, ambiguous problem than manage the team solving it.

The ideal background

• 8+ years of hands-on engineering experience, including real time spent as an architect or equivalent senior technical authority, not just a senior engineer with a bigger title

• A track record of owning multi-year technology strategy or platform architecture decisions that other teams had to live with — and that held up

• Has led major RFCs or architecture proposals cross-team, through genuine pushback, to an actual decision

• Comfortable making build-vs-buy and technology-adoption calls that account for cost, risk, and where the market is heading, not just what's technically interesting

• Experience mentoring senior engineers or Tech Leads toward architect-level thinking, without needing formal authority to do it

• Practical, current experience with AI-assisted development, and a clear point of view on where it genuinely helps versus where it creates risk

Why Factbird?

People are at the heart of everything we build. We believe great products come from empowered teams — and we work hard to create an environment where you can do your best work and have space for life beyond it.

Here's what you can look forward to:

• Flexible working hours: We trust you to manage your time. Life isn't one-size-fits-all, and neither is work.

• Competitive salary: We offer compensation that reflects your skills, experience, and impact.

• Internet reimbursement: Stay connected and productive, wherever you choose to work from.

• A career path that grows with you: Through bi-yearly Individual Development Plan conversations, we'll work together to shape a career journey that fits your ambitions.

• A global, inclusive culture: We're proud of our diverse backgrounds and perspectives — and we actively celebrate them in how we work and collaborate.

If this role feels like a match, we'd be excited to hear from you and explore how you could help shape the future of data collection and production monitoring at Factbird.

And if someone in your network comes to mind who might be a great fit — feel free to share this opportunity with them.
